Title: MemorySmith.Agent — IMemoryGateway and MemorySmith REST API
Content:
## Interface

`IMemoryGateway` (`Agent.Core.Interfaces`) has 4 methods:

| Method | Signature | Returns |
|--------|-----------|---------|
| `SearchAsync` | `(query, ct)` | `IReadOnlyList<SearchResult>` |
| `GetPageAsync` | `(slug, ct)` | `string?` (page body) |
| `CreatePageAsync` | `(slug, title, body, minimumRole, ct)` | `string` (slug) |
| `UpdatePageAsync` | `(pageId, content, title?, ct)` | void |

## RestMemoryGateway (`Agent.Memory/RestMemoryGateway.cs`)

Implements `IMemoryGateway` via MemorySmith REST endpoints:

| Operation | HTTP | Endpoint |
|-----------|------|----------|
| Search | GET | `/api/search?query={q}&limit=20` |
| GetPage | GET | `/api/pages/{slug}` |
| CreatePage | POST | `/api/pages {slug, title, body, minimumRole}` |
| UpdatePage | PUT | `/api/pages/{slug}` |

`SearchResult.Kind` field distinguishes:
- `"page"`: slug is usable in `GetPageAsync`
- `"memory"`: UUID-based identifier (NOT a valid page slug)

## Configuration (`RestMemoryGatewayOptions`)

Bound from `appsettings.json` section `"Agent:Memory"`:

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `BaseUrl` | string | `http://localhost:5000` | MemorySmith base URL |
| `ApiKey` | string? | null | `X-Api-Key` header if configured |
| `TimeoutSeconds` | int | 30 | HTTP request timeout |
| `DefaultPageRole` | string | `"Anonymous"` | Default role for created pages |
| `ItemCacheTtlSeconds` | int | 60 | In-memory cache TTL for item registry lookups |
| `NullCacheTtlSeconds` | int | 5 | Sprint 45 TSK-0092: shorter TTL for null cache entries (reduces repeated null lookups) |
| `WorldKbUrl` | string? | null | Sprint 22: separate URL for World KB gateway (null = disabled) |
| `WorldApiKey` | string? | null | API key for World KB gateway |
| `WorldTimeoutSeconds` | int | 30 | Timeout for World KB gateway requests |

### Dual Gateway Configuration

The agent supports two independent REST gateways:
1. **Primary gateway** (`BaseUrl`/`ApiKey`/`TimeoutSeconds`): general MemorySmith wiki access
2. **World KB gateway** (`WorldKbUrl`/`WorldApiKey`/`WorldTimeoutSeconds`): separate endpoint for world-specific knowledge

When `WorldKbUrl` is null (default), the World KB gateway is disabled and all requests go through the primary gateway.

## Error Handling (Sprint 45+)

`SearchAsync` and other HTTP methods wrap all calls in try/catch (Sprint 53 TSK-0193):

| Exception | Handling |
|-----------|----------|
| `HttpRequestException` | `LogWarning`, return `[]` (or null for GetPage) |
| `TaskCanceledException` (timeout) | `LogWarning`, return `[]` (or null for GetPage) |
| `JsonException` | `LogWarning`, return `[]` |
| `OperationCanceledException` | Propagate (cooperative cancellation) |

Pattern:
```csharp
try
{
    var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync(url, ct);
    // ... process response
}
catch (OperationCanceledException) { throw; }
catch (Exception ex) when (ex is HttpRequestException or TaskCanceledException or JsonException)
{
    logger?.LogWarning(ex, "SearchAsync failed for query {Query}: {Message}", query, ex.Message);
    return [];
}
```

## UpdatePageAsync Dual Paths (Sprint 51 TSK-0138)

| Path | Condition | Behavior |
|------|-----------|----------|
| **Explicit title** | `title` parameter provided | Skip GET, use title directly |
| **No title** | `title` is null | GET existing page first, extract title from response; 404-only catch for upsert fallback (TSK-0111) |

Key rules:
- Explicit title path eliminates the race condition between GET and PUT
- Auth failures, timeouts, and 500s propagate to avoid silent data loss
- Only `404 Not Found` is caught for upsert fallback; all other errors propagate

## Caching

- `ItemCacheTtlSeconds` (default 60): in-memory `ConcurrentDictionary` cache for item registry lookups
- `NullCacheTtlSeconds` (default 5): shorter TTL for null entries (prevents repeated cache-miss HTTP calls)
- Set `ItemCacheTtlSeconds = 0` to disable caching entirely
- Cache entries include expiry check: `DateTimeOffset.UtcNow < entry.Expires`
